description: Addition of second floor rear closet wing extension; replacement of existing second floor artificial slate hanging with natural slate hanging; relocation of existing north front roof window; addition of aluminium framed flat rooflight to flat roof above stair; replacement of single glazed wood sliding sash and casement windows with triple glazed uPVC sliding sash and casement windows; replacement of second floor rear Juliet balcony and double glazed wood French windows with triple glazed aluminium framed casement windows; replacement of double glazed ground floor rear wood roof window, and sliding folding doors and fixed light with aluminium framed roof window, and sliding folding doors and fixed light; addition of ground floor rear side aluminium framed casement window; replacement of existing first and second floor uPVC rainwater goods with black coloured aluminium rainwater goods; installation of air conditioning condenser unit on first floor roof against rear wall of closet wing.
